title: Rava Ze’ira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Arakhin 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.16b.21): Rava Ze’ira — and some say Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani — challenges it (Rabbi Elazar’s words): “They said even more than this — and you say…,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Rava Ze’ira and Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani as alternative challengers of Rabbi Elazar’s statement. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3103&lang=en) records the same alternatives but gives a different folio.
